title: Greens Chosen by Gut
text: Today, a green side dish for your gut! I'm cooking garlic broccoli!
speaker: Chef Gut

title: Simple, Everyday Ingredients
text: One hundred fifty grams of broccoli, one garlic clove, one teaspoon of oil, and two tablespoons of water.
speaker: Narrator

title: 01  Slice the Stalk Too
text: Wash and cut into bite-sized florets. Thinly slice the stalk, so you can eat that too!
speaker: Chef Gut

title: 02  Add Water and Cover
text: Put broccoli and water in the pan. Cover and cook over medium heat for about three minutes.
speaker: Narrator

title: 03  Gently Fry with Garlic
text: Let the water evaporate, then turn the heat to medium-low. Add oil and minced garlic. Fry for about one minute.
speaker: Chef Gut

title: Tender Stalks? Ready!
text: Once the stalks are tender, it's ready! Season lightly, just how you like it.
speaker: Chef Gut

title: Why Did Gut Choose This?
text: Broccoli adds fiber. Fiber and enough fluids help keep stools soft and easier to pass.
speaker: Narrator

title: Build Up Slowly. Drink Water.
text: Build up your fiber slowly, rather than all at once! And remember water. That's Chef Gut's tip!
speaker: Narrator

title: Save Me Some Water!
text: Don't just save my vegetables. Save me a glass of water too! I'm thirsty!
speaker: Chef Gut

title: Screenshot Your Next Side!
text: Subscribe for your employee badge! Likes are your bonus!
speaker: Chef Gut
